title: agent-signals manifest (monitors.yaml)
description: The single source of truth adapters are generated from. Normative source: event-contract.md §Manifest. Enforced by the manifest validator, not expressible here: rejection of duplicate source names including case-folded aliases across entries, duplicate-key rejection in the YAML document itself, and rejection of a source whose rotate_bytes exceeds retention_bytes / 2. A well-formed on-skill-invoke trigger naming a nonexistent skill passes validation; adapter generation surfaces the unresolvable slug as a warning where the harness makes its skill set enumerable.

name.description: Canonical lowercase path-safe slug; source paths are formed only after validation, and the grammar (no separators, no leading dot) plus the length bound keeps every value filename-safe (event-contract.md §Manifest).

command.description: Non-empty argv array executed without a shell; empty elements are rejected. Relative paths resolve against the manifest's directory (event-contract.md §Manifest).

trigger.description: Exactly two forms — session-start, or on-skill-invoke:<slug> with the slug following the name grammar and bound; adapters degrade the richest form a harness lacks (event-contract.md §Manifest).

tiers.description: Which adapters to emit for this source; unknown tier names are rejected (event-contract.md §Manifest).

follow.description: Declares that the watcher implements --follow; the service never passes the flag to a source that does not declare it (event-contract.md §Manifest, §Watcher requirements).

severity_floor.description: Enforced before spool append; below-floor events are counted in diagnostics but not retained, and still advance the watcher ingest checkpoint (event-contract.md §Manifest).

batch_size.description: Caps returned events before the adapter's encoded-byte cap; lower host limits may reduce it further but never increase it (event-contract.md §Manifest).

max_event_bytes.description: Raw UTF-8 bytes per JSONL event including the trailing newline, enforced with a bounded line reader before JSON decoding; the floor guarantees room for a minimal valid event (event-contract.md §Manifest).

interval.description: Seconds between pull-mode invocations for a watcher without --follow, and the backoff ceiling in follow mode; the floor prevents a misconfigured source from hot-looping (event-contract.md §Manifest, §Watcher requirements).

rotate_bytes.description: Segment rotation threshold in bytes; the validator additionally rejects a value exceeding retention_bytes / 2 so the retention ceiling always has a removable segment (event-contract.md §Manifest, §Rotation).

retention_bytes.description: Hard per-source retention ceiling in bytes; overrides cursor pinning, with the affected cursor taking the gap path (event-contract.md §Manifest, §Rotation).

retention_age.description: Optional age bound in seconds, measured from the durable ingest time of a segment's newest event; unset by default (event-contract.md §Manifest, §Rotation).

cursor_grace.description: Cursor expiry grace period in seconds from event-contract.md §Cursor lifecycle; retention may ignore an expired cursor only after it (event-contract.md §Manifest).

idle_timeout.description: Supervision idle bound in seconds — time since the last byte on the watcher's stdout or stderr; on expiry the service kills the process group (event-contract.md §Manifest, §Watcher requirements).
